entities.name: Jared Carthalion
entities.description: A wayfarer, aged sixteen by the end, who learns magic from Kristina, destroys the Golgothian Sylex and triggers his planeswalker spark.

entities.name: Kristina of the Woods
entities.description: A planeswalker and one of the Sages of Minorad who heals and mentors Jared and becomes his lover.

entities.name: Ravidel
entities.description: A battlemage and planeswalker, resurrected by Kristina, who seeks vengeance on the Sages with the Golgothian Sylex and serves the master Taysir.

entities.name: Élan d'Avenant
entities.description: An archer hired by Kadesha to hunt Jared who is eventually used against Ravidel, her true enemy, and killed by him.

entities.name: Kadesha
entities.description: The ruler of the town of Hamath who sends a thunder spirit against Jared.

entities.name: Liana of Minorad
entities.description: A planeswalker and one of the Sages of Minorad who holds three Moxes and sends herself and Ravidel into the Abyss.

entities.name: Taysir
entities.description: Kristina's former lover and Ravidel's master.

entities.name: Grenfell Mor
entities.description: A planeswalker, one of the Sages of Minorad and Jared's maternal grandfather, who betrays Jared and Kristina.

entities.name: Altair of Coloni
entities.description: One of the Sages of Minorad who rides the nightmare Caliphear and sacrifices himself to destroy the Demon.

entities.name: Caliphear
entities.description: A nightmare ridden by Altair that teaches Jared about black mana.

entities.name: Hoont
entities.description: A spitting slug Jared bonds with, killed by Ravidel's Lord of the Pit.

entities.name: Daria
entities.description: Taysir's daughter who follows the Mox Beacon and helps Jared trigger his planeswalker spark.

entities.name: Gwendolyn Carthalion
entities.description: Jared's deceased mother and founder of Telemar.

entities.name: Adam Carthalion
entities.description: Jared's father, who sacrificed his wife.

entities.name: Exarch Finovar
entities.description: Leader of the Calthyn Elves who feuds with Amadis over speaking to the Great Spirit.

entities.name: Exarch Amadis
entities.description: Leader of the Kieryn Elves who hosts Jared and Kristina.

entities.name: Renalt
entities.description: A bard of the Kieryn village who tells of the history of the Quirion Elves.

entities.name: The Great Spirit
entities.description: A newly awoken Force of Nature that tells Jared Ravidel is alive.

entities.name: Scarlet Vizier
entities.description: Ravidel's servant, to whom Liana was indentured, later resurrected as a zombie and destroyed by Ravidel.

entities.name: Sages of Minorad
entities.description: A group of planeswalkers including Embereck, Liana, Altair, Kristina and Grenfell, punished by Ravidel.

entities.name: Golgothian Sylex
entities.description: Ravidel's device with which he threatens to wipe out Minorad; Jared destroys it.

entities.name: Rust Daggers
entities.description: A pair of daggers that can destroy the Sylex.

entities.name: The Moxes
entities.description: Three Moxes held by Liana, later stolen by Ravidel to send a beacon across the Blind Eternities.

entities.name: Foecleaver
entities.description: Jared's sword, lost in his first fight and later returned repaired.

entities.name: Minorad
entities.description: The magic academy site laid waste by Ravidel.

entities.name: Planeswalker War
entities.description: The now-inevitable war that Jared and Kristina prepare for after Ravidel's beacon.

events.summary: Jared battles a thunder spirit sent by Kadesha and loses his sword Foecleaver.
events.quote: He defeats the spirit, but at the cost of his sword, Foecleaver.

events.summary: Kadesha enlists the archer Élan d'Avenant to stop Jared.
events.quote: Kadesha enlists the archer Élan d'Avenant

events.summary: Kristina intervenes and teleports Jared away as he is about to kill Élan.
events.quote: when Kristina of the Woods intervenes and teleports him away.

events.summary: Kristina reveals she is a planeswalker and becomes Jared's mentor.
events.quote: She reveals to him that she's also a Planeswalker

events.summary: Kristina teaches Jared to bond with the slug Hoont.
events.quote: She teaches him to bond with a spitting slug named Hoont

events.summary: The Great Spirit reveals that Ravidel is alive and hunting Liana and her Moxes.
events.quote: It reveals to Jared that Ravidel is alive and is hunting Liana of Minorad and her three Moxes

events.summary: Jared abandons Kristina and heads north to save Liana.
events.quote: he immediately abandons her and heads north to save Liana from Ravidel.

events.summary: Ravidel duels Liana for her Moxes and reveals his master is Taysir.
events.quote: He reveals to her that his Master is Taysir

events.summary: Jared fixes a Trovash engine while the Shivan Dragon teaches him red magic.
events.quote: Over several days, Jared fixes the engine while the dragon teaches him about red magic.

events.summary: Ravidel lays waste to Minorad.
events.quote: Ravidel has broken his promise, and laid waste to Minorad

events.summary: Élan shoots Ravidel and Ravidel kills her with a blast of fire.
events.quote: Ravidel reciprocates, killing her with a blast of fire.

events.summary: Liana gives Jared her Moxes and sends herself and Ravidel into the Abyss.
events.quote: She then casts a spell to send herself and Ravidel into the Abyss

events.summary: Jared and Kristina meet Grenfell Mor in Telemar and learn the history of the Sages.
events.quote: they meet the Planeswalker Grenfell Mor

events.summary: Grenfell betrays Jared and Kristina; Kristina beats him in a duel.
events.quote: Kristina manages to beat Grenfell in the ensuing duel

events.summary: Jared and Kristina become lovers.
events.quote: The two become lovers that evening

events.summary: Ravidel resurrects the Scarlet Vizier as a zombie and destroys him.
events.quote: the battlemage Ravidel briefly resurrects the Scarlet Vizier as a zombie to torment him

events.summary: The Lord of House Khone refuses to join Jared and Kristina against Ravidel.
events.quote: They beseech the Lord of House Khone to join them against Ravidel, but he refuses

events.summary: Jared destroys the Golgothian Sylex with the Rust Daggers.
events.quote: Jared has the Rust Daggers and uses them to cast a Shatter spell on the Sylex, destroying it.

events.summary: Altair sacrifices himself to destroy the Demon.
events.quote: Altair sacrifices himself to destroy the Demon

events.summary: Ravidel steals the three Moxes and sends a beacon for other planeswalkers.
events.quote: Ravidel steals the three Moxes from Kristina

events.summary: Jared destroys the ground under Ravidel, who falls into the chasm.
events.quote: Jared destroys the ground under Ravidel who falls into the chasm

events.summary: Daria helps Jared trigger his planeswalker spark and he planeswalks away with Kristina.
events.quote: he Planeswalks away from the destruction with Kristina
